items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I finally got Donald Bailey. That was my favorite. He is my favorite drummer, Donald Bailey -- and I got him. And that was the beginning of my trio.

ctx.x: Oh yeah! He could stride like crazy. He was a Stride piano player. Yeah, once he got all warmed up, he'd go... He got me all acquainted with James P. Johnson, that's all he would listen to. You know, Fats and Donald
